name: agent-machines-installation-cells
description: Tier-P F1 dual-cell scenario: two independent marketplace identities carrying Agent Machines install and run in isolated cells, one updates and rolls back without changing the other, blocked governance states never fall back to legacy, and unrelated or payload-only identities cannot adopt required installation context.

inputs.CR_UV_INDEX: optional package index used when the clean-room host cannot reach the public Python registry

expected_artifacts: scenario result state beneath the runner-owned results directory

stages.title: operative eligibility and full cell-provision locking hold
two active Agent Machines cells install and run independently
one cell updates without changing its peer
historical owned slot rolls back without changing its peer
requested-only malformed foreign maintenance and orphaned states fail closed

notes: All namespaced receipts, runtimes, policies, and scenario output live in the disposable clean-room account or the runner-owned results directory.
The mounted source remains read-only and no persistent host installation is selected.
